title: Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)
description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. Candidates who have shipped a partner portal go to the top of the list

Lending domain: Salesforce in financial services or consumer lending — origination lifecycle, borrower and partner (dealer / installer) journeys

Loan\-origination package: hands\-on with a Salesforce\-native loan/lease origination managed package. Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix experience strongly preferred

Delivery leadership: has led a delivery team of engineers on at least one client\-facing Salesforce implementation — owned the solution design, ran code review and releases, and was accountable to the client for the outcome; has owned the integration on at least one ERP\-connected implementation

Salesforce core: Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, asynchronous Apex, Platform Events; Named Credentials; Salesforce CDC, Bulk and Streaming APIs; hands\-on on the hardest stories

APIs and integrations: REST, GraphQL and SOAP; API design — contracts, versioning, auth, error semantics; an integration platform of the Workato / MuleSoft / Boomi class; AWS Lambda, API Gateway and SQS

NetSuite integration (hands\-on): SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP) or RESTlets; quote\-to\-cash and order\-to\-cash object flows between Salesforce and NetSuite

Snowflake and data reconciliation (hands\-on): Salesforce CDC or batch extraction into Snowflake; reconciling platform data against ERP and finance

Delivery tooling: SFDX, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD, PMD; release checklists; Jira and Confluence

Communication: camera\-on meetings, direct stakeholder communication in clear English; written status a client can act on; raises risks early, never late; works the US business calendar and US federal holidays

Experience: 8\+ years on the Salesforce platform, including tech\-lead experience running a delivery team and hands\-on delivery on at least one lending or portal\-heavy implementation

NICE TO HAVE

Portal login federated to an external identity provider (OIDC / SAML single sign\-on for Experience Cloud users); multi\-org or org\-consolidation experience

Sales, Service and Financial Services Cloud breadth; Einstein and Agentforce; AI\-assisted engineering workflows on masked or synthetic data only

Event\-driven architecture — Kafka or Azure Event Hubs; AWS S3 and Step Functions

Solar\-financing, renewable\-energy or fintech domain; prior work with US enterprise clients from offshore

CERTIFICATIONS

Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I

Preferred: Platform Developer II and Integration Architect; Experience Cloud Site Consultant; Application Architect a plus

Pay: ₹24,683\.02 \- ₹108,778\.66 per month

Work Location: On the road

title: Systems Architect - WLC
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a **Systems Architect \- WLC** to shape the future of connected network operations, defining the target architecture and implementation roadmap for a next\-generation Unified Connectivity Platform integrating Enterprise Wi\-Fi, NMS, ACS, Analytics, Service Assurance and AI\-driven operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead Enterprise Wi\-Fi \& Controller discovery with stakeholders, to validate requirements across WLAN, security, AAA/NAC, RF, client experience and service assurance
* Define the AP–Controller–Cloud architecture hypothesis, including WLC, AP software/firmware, RF intelligence, telemetry and multi\-site management
* Assess OpenWiFi and existing capabilities, to identify Build vs. Reuse vs. Extend opportunities and platform differentiation
* Drive architecture decisions and technical recommendations, to cover SaaS, multi\-tenancy, observability, analytics, integrations, risks and dependencies
* Support MVP prioritization, effort estimation and phased roadmap, to contribute to architecture documentation and executive recommendations
* Translate business requirements into scalable solutions, to evaluate Build vs. Reuse vs. Extend approaches
* Collaborate across Product, Architecture, Engineering and Operations teams

**Requirements**

* 12\-18 years of overall experience in software development
* 12\+ years of experience in Software Architecture \& Development in Enterprise Networking/WLAN, Wireless Controllers, AP management, and large\-scale Wi\-Fi deployments
* Knowledge of Wi\-Fi 5/6/6E/7 and 802\.11 standards
* Expertise in AP software/firmware, AP–Controller communication, onboarding, provisioning, configuration, firmware lifecycle and OTA
* Familiarity with Qualcomm/MediaTek platforms
* Background in RF/RRM, channel and power management, band steering, load balancing, roaming, airtime fairness and interference management
* Knowledge of WPA2/WPA3, 802\.1X, RADIUS/AAA, NAC, Dynamic VLAN, MAB and policy\-based access control
* Skills in Wi\-Fi telemetry, monitoring, observability, service assurance, client experience and network analytics
* Understanding of OpenWiFi/uCentral, microservices, REST APIs and event\-driven/SaaS architectures
* Proficiency in SNMP, NETCONF, MQTT, gRPC/gNMI and streaming telemetry

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a seasoned **System Architect \- Wireless Embedded** to spearhead the architecture design of a cloud\-native Unified Connectivity Platform covering Enterprise Wi\-Fi, NMS, ACS, Analytics, and Service Assurance. This position will oversee AP software, firmware, chipset/SDK, and AP–Controller architecture, contributing to the Discovery \& Architecture phase to establish the MVP, target architecture, and future roadmap for connected network operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct AP software / wireless embedded architecture discovery in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders, establishing the target AP software and device architecture
* Design AP–Controller–Cloud integration, encompassing communication, authentication, onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and policy synchronization
* Establish device lifecycle, interoperability, and device\-cloud interfaces throughout the platform
* Build the AP software stack spanning 802\.11, drivers, embedded Linux/OpenWrt, EasyMesh/prplMesh/OpenWiFi, and chipset/SDK ecosystems
* Establish firmware lifecycle and OTA architecture, covering versioning, compatibility, rollout, and rollback
* Set up diagnostics, telemetry, logging, health monitoring, and operational visibility mechanisms
* Assess Build vs. Reuse vs. Extend options across assets, OpenWiFi, chipset/vendor SDKs, and third\-party components
* Pinpoint architecture, performance, security, and interoperability implementation risks
* Partner with Enterprise Wi\-Fi/WLC and Cloud/Platform Architects to align AP capabilities, RF/RRM, client intelligence, security, and roaming requirements
* Contribute to architecture decisions, prioritization, estimation, roadmap, and phased delivery

**Requirements**

* 12\-18 years of overall IT experience
* 12\+ years working in AP software development, wireless embedded systems development, networking devices, gateways, or related product engineering
* Deep knowledge of AP software/firmware architecture, embedded Linux, device architecture, and product engineering
* Background in AP onboarding, provisioning, configuration management, device lifecycle, firmware management, and OTA update mechanisms
* Grasp of AP–Controller communication, control/data\-plane interactions, WLAN management, and device lifecycle workflows
* Practical knowledge of Wi\-Fi 5, Wi\-Fi 6, Wi\-Fi 6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and IEEE 802\.11 technologies
* Background in Wi\-Fi driver development, middleware, and SDK integration, including 802\.11 stack components, performance, and debugging
* Experience working with Qualcomm, MediaTek, Broadcom, Intel, or similar Wi\-Fi chipset platforms and SDK ecosystems
* Background in embedded Linux, drivers, BSPs, middleware, hardware abstraction, and device\-level software development \& architecture
* Capability to evaluate chipset/SDK constraints and convert them into architecture, integration, performance, and roadmap decisions
* Knowledge of MQTT, SNMP, NETCONF, gRPC/gNMI, Syslog, and streaming telemetry frameworks
* Experience linking device software with cloud\-native platforms, REST APIs, event\-driven services, and SaaS/device\-cloud architectures
* Ability to convert requirements into scalable device/software solutions while working across Product, Architecture, Cloud, Firmware, Hardware, QA, and Operations teams

**Nice to have**

* Background in OpenWiFi / TIP OpenWiFi / uCentral / OpenWrt / EasyMesh / prplMesh or similar ecosystems

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Manager.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of individual contributor engineer roles with low to moderate complexity and less experienced managers who are responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Engage with architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture to enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example, cloud readiness, application modernization and data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to make decisions and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement culture
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop, and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with low to moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate and consult with the Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology engineering including career development and performance management for engineers and managers on the team
* Hire, mentor and guide talent development of direct reports to build the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for the supported product areas/products

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience

**Desired Qualification**

* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Solid background in system design, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with Kafka, relational/NoSQL databases, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of engineering best practices and production support.
* Proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams.
* Ability to operate as both a technical leader and people manager.

27 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

title: Senior Specialist, EHS Solution Architecture
description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data\-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital\-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.


Role Overview
  
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands\-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data\-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current\-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, guide proof\-of\-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
* Define the MEEHS target architecture: Develop current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability: Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data\-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs: Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models: Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital\-thread capabilities: Conceptualize and assess digital\-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments: Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness: Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI\-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine\-learning use cases, and future agent\-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership: Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non\-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions: Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance: Incorporate secure\-by\-design, least\-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset: Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.


What You Should Have
  
  

**Primary Skills:** TOGAF
  
  

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
* Enterprise System Integration


AI/Machine Learning Architecture
  
  

* Secondary Skills: CAD/BIM Platforms (Autodesk, Bentley)
* CMMS / Asset Reliability Platforms
* EHS Platforms (Enablon, Sphera, Cority, Intelex)
* Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of IT experience, including substantial experience in system architecture, solution architecture, enterprise integration, application modernization, and data\-platform design.
* Demonstrated experience creating solution, integration, application, data, cloud, security, and deployment architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* Experience designing interoperability across COTS, SaaS, vendor\-hosted, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise platforms using reusable integration and information patterns.
* Experience architecting data hubs, data platforms, warehouses, lakes or lakehouses, semantic models, metadata and lineage capabilities, data quality controls, and governed analytical consumption.
* Experience progressing concepts from discovery and feasibility assessment through proof of concept, pilot, implementation, rollout, operational transition, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, infrastructure, integration, data and analytics, procurement, service management, vendors, and managed service teams.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.


Technical Knowledge
  
* Architecture methods and modeling: Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability: API\-first and event\-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance: Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role\-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture: Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains: Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project\-to\-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.
* Analytics and AI enablement: Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms, analytical data preparation, feature\-ready datasets, vector and semantic retrieval concepts, knowledge graphs, responsible AI controls, data provenance, model monitoring, and human oversight.
* Cybersecurity and identity: Zero Trust, secure\-by\-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations: SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.


Non\-Technical Skills and Competencies
  
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product\-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Ability to facilitate discovery, architecture workshops, trade\-off decisions, design reviews, feasibility assessments, and cross\-functional alignment using clear decision criteria.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non\-technical teams.


Preferred Certifications
  
  

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.


Working Hours and Expectations
  
  

* This is primarily an office\-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on\-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.
* Participate in planned architecture workshops, proof\-of\-concept activities, releases, cutovers, disaster\-recovery exercises, and occasional off\-hours support for critical implementation or production events in accordance with established procedures.
* Occasional travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, project teams, vendor engagements, architecture workshops, or implementation activities.


Performance Measures
  
* Delivery of approved current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures, reference patterns, architecture decisions, implementation roadmaps, and technical work packages aligned with agreed scope and outcomes.
* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
* Progress in establishing central data hubs with trusted ingestion, transformation, metadata, lineage, quality, semantic modeling, access, and consumption capabilities.
* Business acceptance and measurable use of governed data for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and prioritized AI use cases.
* Feasibility assessments and architecture recommendations that provide clear options, trade\-offs, dependencies, cost and risk considerations, and executable next steps.
* Compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, GMP/GxP, validation, data integrity, records, operational resilience, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Reduction of duplicate integrations, fragmented data flows, unsupported technologies, manual reconciliation, technical debt, vendor dependency, and lifecycle risk through documented architecture actions.
* Consistently demonstrates strong work ethic, ownership, accountability, integrity, and sound judgment while fostering inclusive, respectful, and collaborative behavior, sharing knowledge, seeking diverse perspectives, and contributing positively to cross\-functional team outcomes.


Who We Are
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing medicines and vaccines for many of the world’s most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to advance innovative health solutions for people and animals around the world.
  
  

What We Look For
  
We seek a pragmatic and forward\-looking architect who combines technical depth with product thinking and delivery focus. The successful candidate will be able to move between strategy and implementation, simplify complex ecosystems, establish trusted data foundations, guide cross\-functional decisions, and create secure, compliant, interoperable, and sustainable digital capabilities for EHS.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Architectural Design, Architectural Design, Architectural Review, Cloud Computing, Cloud Computing Services, Data Encryption, Data Modeling, Delivery Management, Deployment Strategies, Design Applications, Enterprise Systems Integration, Integration Architecture, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), Knowledge Sharing, Microsoft Azure, NoSQL, Platform Design, Project Architecture, Proof of Concept (POC), Release Management, Requirements Management, Software Interoperability, Solution Architecture, System Designs, System Integration {\+ 1 more}

title: Alpha Business Process Automation, Assistant Manager
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for a hands\-on Senior AI Engineer with strong software engineering experience to build and deploy secure, production\-grade AI agents. The ideal candidate has experience with agent frameworks, orchestration, enterprise integrations, evaluation and guardrails, AWS Bedrock or equivalent cloud services, and modern deployment practices. Knowledge of responsible AI and governance is essential; experience with Knowledge Graphs, RAG, or GraphRAG is an advantage.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

This role is central to building secure, scalable, and production\-grade AI capabilities that improve how enterprise processes are delivered. By engineering intelligent agents, multi\-agent workflows, enterprise integrations, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and cloud\-native deployment patterns, the Senior AI Engineer will help automate complex work, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate reliable AI adoption. The role also strengthens enterprise knowledge and reasoning through complementary knowledge graph capabilities while ensuring solutions meet responsible AI, security, governance, auditability, and production\-support requirements.

  

**About the team — Alpha Intelligence**

Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI \& Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front\-to\-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go\-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.


We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible\-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

This role will primarily focus on designing, engineering, deploying, and operating secure, production\-grade Agentic AI capabilities, with a complementary focus on knowledge graph and Graph RAG solutions that improve enterprise grounding, retrieval, and reasoning.

  

* Design, develop, and integrate AI agents with enterprise APIs, applications, tools, data sources, knowledge repositories, and workflow services.
* Build reusable agent workflows using Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Llama Index, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent frameworks, applying modular and maintainable engineering patterns.
* Engineer single\-agent and multi\-agent orchestration, including planning, routing, memory, state management, tool or function calling, retries, checkpointing, and failure recovery.
* Establish agent evaluation and observability using Lang Smith or equivalent tools, including test datasets, quality metrics, execution traces, regression testing, and production monitoring.
* Implement human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, agent guardrails, structured evaluation, and responsible execution controls for sensitive, high\-impact, or irreversible actions.
* Configure and integrate AWS Bedrock Agents, Guardrails, foundation models, and equivalent cloud\-native agent services.
* Package and deploy agent services using containers, serverless patterns, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise cloud security controls.
* Apply Responsible AI, data privacy, access control, auditability, model\-risk, and AI\-governance requirements across design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Contribute to ontology and knowledge graph design, graph data modeling, ingestion, entity and relationship enrichment, lineage, provenance, and semantic validation using enterprise graph technologies.
* Build supporting Python APIs and RAG or Graph RAG components, including document processing, hybrid retrieval, graph traversal, grounding, source attribution, citations, testing, troubleshooting, performance tuning, documentation, and cross\-functional delivery.
  

**What we value**

The successful candidate must have excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills and be able to communicate complex AI, graph, data, and architecture concepts to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior technology leaders. The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, structured problem solving, pragmatic architecture, reusable engineering, collaboration, and a consistent focus on secure, reliable, measurable, and governed enterprise AI outcomes.

  

**Must\-have skills**

* Experience developing or integrating AI agents with enterprise APIs, tools, data sources, knowledge repositories, and workflow services.
* Experience with agent frameworks such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Llama Index, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Experience with Lang smith and AI Eval tools, or equivalent.
* Exposure to single\-agent and multi\-agent orchestration, tool or function calling, agent memory, planning, routing, and state management.
* Experience implementing human\-in\-the\-loop controls, agent guardrails, structured agent evaluation, and responsible execution patterns.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock Agents, Guardrails, foundation model integrations, or equivalent cloud\-native agent services.
* Experience with containerization, serverless deployment, infrastructure code, or enterprise cloud security patterns.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on\-site role where you'll be embedded in the Data Centers you support, serving as the voice of Builders and the strategic HR partner to site leadership. You'll work across a cluster of Data Centers, visiting sites daily to ensure every Builder feels valued, engaged, and supported.
  

  

What we are looking for:  

* Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence.

* Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization, from builders to senior site leaders, without direct authority.
* Coaching. Develop site leadership in the flow of work.

  

This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites within an operational cluster (estimated 25% travel).  

* Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off\-shift populations and respond to time\-sensitive people matters is expected.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross\-functional partnership.

  

Key job responsibilities  

Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks \& Gemba walks. Proactively monitor Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Establish relationships with employee representative boards.  

  

Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Identify root causes using sentiment trends and HR data and provide site\-level recommendations to site leadership. Coordinate cluster\-wide communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.  

  

HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem\-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Resolve complex cases independently, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues—applying empathy and sound judgment. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Infrastructure Engineer to drive the engineering, modernization, and operational excellence of the enterprise tracing and application performance monitoring (APM) ecosystem. This role is responsible for the design, engineering, automation, scalability, security, and reliability of enterprise observability platforms including Splunk Observability Cloud (SPLOC), AppDynamics, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and associated tracing infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines deep infrastructure engineering expertise with modern AI\-driven observability practices to deliver intelligent troubleshooting, automated instrumentation, proactive detection, and enterprise\-scale telemetry solutions. The engineer will partner with application teams, SREs, platform engineers, architects, and product leaders to expand observability adoption and accelerate incident detection and resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design highly available, scalable, and resilient tracing solutions supporting enterprise workloads on SPLOC, AppDynamics, and Dynatrace platforms.
* Engineer cloud\-native observability solutions across Kubernetes, OpenShift, virtual machines, and hybrid environments.
* Develop and maintain tracing gateways, collectors, agents, and telemetry pipelines.
* Define and implement enterprise OpenTelemetry standards and instrumentation strategies.
* Enable automated instrumentation across Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, and emerging technology stacks.
* Design telemetry collection architectures using OpenTelemetry Collectors and modern observability patterns.
* Design and enable AI\-assisted troubleshooting capabilities.
* Evaluate and integrate AI agents for tracing, logging, performance analytics, and root\-cause determination.
* Partner with data and AI teams to build observability copilots and intelligent operational workflows.
* Automate agent deployment, upgrades, monitoring validation, and compliance checks.
* Build self\-service onboarding capabilities to accelerate application adoption.
* Serve as the technical lead for tracing and APM platforms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, SRE, or observability domains.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with enterprise APM and tracing platforms: Splunk Observability Cloud (SignalFx/SPLOC), AppDynamics or Dynatrace
* Deep understanding of Distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes/OpenShift
* Experience with automation languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Strong understanding of enterprise monitoring, performance engineering, and observability practices.
* Experience implementing OpenTelemetry at enterprise scale.
* Knowledge of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents, and AIOps solutions.
* Experience integrating observability data with ServiceNow, automation, and incident management platforms.
* Expertise in OpenShift, container observability, and modern telemetry pipelines.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise migrations and modernization initiatives.

description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: EPM Solution Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**  

As an **EPM Solution Engineer**, you will act as a key technical expert for SGS's Hyperion, Essbase and related EPM applications, driving their development, stability and continuous improvement. You will ensure solutions follow industry best practices for coding, architecture, security and performance while applying your expertise across the software development lifecycle.


You will play an active role in development and enhancement initiatives, ensuring business requirements are understood, challenged where necessary, and translated into scalable, sustainable solutions. You will assess the impact of new requirements and provide technical guidance that balances business needs with long\-term system integrity and maintainability.


You will oversee the maintenance and support of EPM applications, including metadata management, calculation scripts, business rules, reports and dashboards. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and service providers, you will manage requests, support incident resolution and contribute to strategic initiatives such as platform upgrades, ERP transformation projects and the evolution of Oracle EPM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee that the software development activity is carried out in accordance with SGS and market standards.
* Executes the validation of the technical designs \& oversees the application development activity and ensures that deliverables follow the defined \& market coding, architecture and security rules and guidelines.
* Ensuring that development estimates made by partners are reasonable and acceptable.
* Ensure that the development activities in the field of applications development and projects comply with the SGS technical standards and quality.
* Monitor 2nd or 3rd Level Support, working closely with AM Teams, business users, infrastructure team and application outsourcer (Oracle).
* Attend internal and external service meetings to discuss issues and improvement plans.
* Manage and monitor issues closely and ensure their resolution according to applicable escalation procedures.
* Perform regular service quality checks on incident tickets and requests and prepare improvement plans.
* Maintain the access and security configurations, ensuring the right level of control in line with the standards required by system auditors and internal controls.
* Monitor monthly maintenance activities: Maintain metadata, member list, FX Rates, business rules and validation checks.
* Support the year end Rollover activities, and support any other activity related financial closing.
* Oversee technical architecture activities such as patching, backups or application copies, working closely with DBA and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams, Solution Architects, Delivery managers and Application Outsourcers for any initiative that will require SGS engagement.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years’ experience in Hyperion or related EPM products** on any of the following processes:
	+ Financial Planning and Budgeting.
	+ Enterprise Data Management \& **Essbase**.
	+ Financial Consolidation and Closing.
	+ EPM Technical Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EPM development, including business rules, calculation scripts, metadata management and reporting.
* Experience supporting, enhancing and maintaining enterprise EPM applications.
* **Oracle EPM Cloud experience** is highly desirable.
* Experience with EPM upgrades, migrations or transformation initiatives is desirable.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles.
* Ability to assess the impact of business requirements and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance business requirements with long\-term system stability and architectural best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence decisions and provide trusted technical guidance.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across global teams and external partners.
* Proactive, flexible and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Embraces change and continuous improvement.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!
